name: morph3d
title: morph3d (Marcelo Fernandes Vianna, 1997; Mesa demos)
_version: mesa-demos 8.0.1 (2010-07-13), the first release of the demos as their own repository: GL 1.x and GLUT only, before the GLEW and later glad loaders and PNG textures arrived.
_doc: Five morphing polyhedra drawn face by face with glBegin(GL_TRIANGLES): two-sided lighting, GL_LIGHT_MODEL_LOCAL_VIEWER off, specular, and a projection rebuilt by glFrustum on every reshape. A second whole program on the GL layer after gears, held to Mesa by tools/gate-mesa-demos.mjs.
